## 0. Setup

This report repeats the selected-watershed deep dive at the HUC4 scale. HUC4 assignment is inherited from the trusted HUC8 assignment using the first four HUC digits.

```{r}
source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(knitr)

dir_processed <- file.path("../data/processed")
dir_merit <- file.path(dir_processed, "merit_data")

path_cat <- file.path(dir_merit, "03_cat_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_riv <- file.path(dir_merit, "03_riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_upstream_lookup <- file.path(dir_merit, "05_upstream_lookup.rds")
path_allometry_data <- file.path(dir_processed, "07_huc08_allometry_input.rds")
path_characteristics <- file.path("../data/raw/dryad_data/scaling_dataset_Qmonth_06082024.csv")

example_month <- 7
missing_area_threshold <- 10
min_reaches <- 20
min_area_range_log10 <- 1
max_terminals_per_order <- 25
```

## 1. Read data

```{r}
merit_cat_v2 <- read_sf(path_cat) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    huc = as.character(huc),
    huc4 = substr(huc, 1, 4)
  )

merit_riv_v2 <- read_sf(path_riv) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    nxt_dw = as.character(nxt_dw),
    huc = as.character(huc),
    huc4 = substr(huc, 1, 4)
  )

upstream_lookup <- base::readRDS(path_upstream_lookup) %>%
  mutate(
    downstream_comid = as.character(downstream_comid),
    upstream_comid = as.character(upstream_comid)
  )

allometry_data <- base::readRDS(path_allometry_data) %>%
  mutate(
    downstream_comid = as.character(downstream_comid),
    huc = as.character(huc),
    huc4 = substr(huc, 1, 4)
  )

comid_characteristics <- read_csv(path_characteristics, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))
```

```{r}
reach_attributes <- merit_riv_v2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(comid, huc, huc4, uparea, any_of("order")) %>%
  left_join(
    merit_cat_v2 %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(comid, unitarea),
    by = "comid"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    comid_characteristics %>%
      select(comid, lengthkm, merit_width, any_of("order")),
    by = "comid",
    suffix = c("_riv", "_dryad")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    order = coalesce(order_riv, order_dryad),
    stream_area_m2 = lengthkm * 1000 * merit_width
  ) %>%
  select(comid, huc, huc4, uparea, unitarea, lengthkm, merit_width, order, stream_area_m2)
```

## 2. Build HUC4 boundaries

```{r}
conus <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "United States of America",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!postal %in% c("AK", "HI", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")

huc04_conus <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = conus,
  type = "huc04"
) %>%
  clean_names()

huc_col <- names(huc04_conus)[names(huc04_conus) %in% c("huc4", "huc_4", "huc04")][1]

huc04_conus <- huc04_conus %>%
  rename(huc4 = all_of(huc_col)) %>%
  mutate(huc4 = as.character(huc4)) %>%
  st_transform(common_crs)
```

## 3. Select six HUC4s

Selection favors HUC4s with many usable reaches, low missing upstream area, broad drainage-area range, and contrasting stream densities.

```{r}
huc4_diagnostics <- allometry_data %>%
  filter(metabolism_metric == "GPP", month == example_month) %>%
  group_by(huc4) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n_distinct(downstream_comid),
    median_pct_area_missing = median(pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_reaches_ge_10pct_missing = mean(pct_area_missing >= 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    log10_area_range = log10(max(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    reach_attributes %>%
      group_by(huc4) %>%
      summarise(total_length_km = sum(lengthkm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "huc4"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    huc04_conus %>%
      mutate(huc4_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6) %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(huc4, huc4_area_km2),
    by = "huc4"
  ) %>%
  mutate(stream_density_km_km2 = total_length_km / huc4_area_km2)
```

```{r}
selected_huc4s <- huc4_diagnostics %>%
  filter(
    n_reaches >= 500,
    median_pct_area_missing < 1,
    pct_reaches_ge_10pct_missing < 5,
    log10_area_range >= 3,
    !is.na(stream_density_km_km2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(stream_density_bin = ntile(stream_density_km_km2, 6)) %>%
  group_by(stream_density_bin) %>%
  arrange(desc(log10_area_range), desc(n_reaches), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(stream_density_km_km2) %>%
  pull(huc4)

selected_huc4s
```

```{r}
huc4_diagnostics %>%
  filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s) %>%
  arrange(stream_density_km_km2) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

## 4a. Location of selected HUC4s

```{r}
selected_huc4_location_map <- huc04_conus %>%
  mutate(
    selected = huc4 %in% selected_huc4s,
    label_huc4 = if_else(selected, huc4, NA_character_)
  )

selected_huc4_labels <- selected_huc4_location_map %>%
  filter(selected) %>%
  st_point_on_surface()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = selected_huc4_location_map,
    fill = "gray94",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = selected_huc4_location_map %>% filter(selected),
    fill = "#d7191c",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = selected_huc4_labels,
    aes(label = huc4),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Selected HUC4s for scaling deep dive") +
  theme_map() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```


## 4. Maps of selected HUC4s {.tabset}

Catchment fill shows local catchment area. Flowline color and width show July cumulative GPP and cumulative drainage area.

```{r}
selected_huc4_boundaries <- huc04_conus %>%
  filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s)

selected_catchments <- merit_cat_v2 %>%
  filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s)

selected_flowlines <- merit_riv_v2 %>%
  filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s) %>%
  left_join(
    allometry_data %>%
      filter(month == example_month, metabolism_metric == "GPP") %>%
      select(downstream_comid, cumulative_gpp = cumulative_flux_g_o2_d, cumulative_area_km2),
    by = c("comid" = "downstream_comid")
  )
```

```{r results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
for (selected_huc4 in selected_huc4s) {
  
  cat("\n\n### HUC4 ", selected_huc4, "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  print(
    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(
        data = selected_catchments %>% filter(huc4 == selected_huc4),
        aes(fill = pmax(unitarea, 0.01)),
        color = NA,
        alpha = 0.6
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = selected_flowlines %>% filter(huc4 == selected_huc4, !is.na(cumulative_gpp)),
        aes(color = cumulative_gpp, linewidth = cumulative_area_km2),
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = selected_huc4_boundaries %>% filter(huc4 == selected_huc4),
        fill = NA,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low = "gray96",
        high = "gray35",
        trans = "log10",
        name = "Local catchment\narea (km²)"
      ) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(
        option = "magma",
        trans = "log10",
        name = "Cumulative GPP\n(g O2 d-1)"
      ) +
      scale_linewidth_continuous(
        trans = "log10",
        range = c(0.03, 0.9),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      labs(title = paste0("HUC4 ", selected_huc4)) +
      theme_map() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
      )
  )
}
```

## 5. Build HUC4 subwatershed dataset

Terminal reaches are selected across stream orders. Each terminal reach defines a subwatershed from the routing lookup. Fits use upstream focal reaches assigned to the same HUC4 reporting unit.

```{r}
terminal_candidates <- upstream_lookup %>%
  count(downstream_comid, name = "n_upstream_lookup_reaches") %>%
  inner_join(
    reach_attributes %>%
      filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s) %>%
      select(
        terminal_comid = comid,
        terminal_huc4 = huc4,
        terminal_order = order,
        terminal_uparea = uparea
      ),
    by = c("downstream_comid" = "terminal_comid")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(terminal_order), n_upstream_lookup_reaches >= min_reaches) %>%
  group_by(terminal_huc4, terminal_order) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_upstream_lookup_reaches), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_terminals_per_order) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(terminal_comid = downstream_comid)
```

```{r}
subwatershed_data <- upstream_lookup %>%
  inner_join(terminal_candidates, by = c("downstream_comid" = "terminal_comid")) %>%
  rename(
    terminal_comid = downstream_comid,
    reach_comid = upstream_comid
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    allometry_data %>%
      rename(
        reach_comid = downstream_comid,
        reach_huc4 = huc4
      ),
    by = "reach_comid"
  ) %>%
  filter(reach_huc4 == terminal_huc4) %>%
  select(
    terminal_huc4,
    terminal_comid,
    terminal_order,
    terminal_uparea,
    reach_comid,
    month,
    metabolism_metric,
    cumulative_area_km2,
    cumulative_flux_g_o2_d,
    pct_area_missing
  )
```

```{r}
subwatershed_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_huc4s = n_distinct(terminal_huc4),
    n_terminal_reaches = n_distinct(terminal_comid),
    n_reach_points = n_distinct(reach_comid)
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

## 6. Fit HUC4 subwatershed scaling relationships

```{r}
subwatershed_fits <- subwatershed_data %>%
  group_by(terminal_huc4, terminal_comid, terminal_order, month, metabolism_metric) %>%
  filter(
    n() >= min_reaches,
    n_distinct(cumulative_area_km2) >= min_reaches,
    log10(max(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)) >= min_area_range_log10
  ) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- lm(log10(cumulative_flux_g_o2_d) ~ log10(cumulative_area_km2), data = .x)
    
    tibble(
      n_reaches = nrow(.x),
      log10_area_range = log10(max(.x$cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(.x$cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      median_pct_area_missing = median(.x$pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
      slope = coef(fit)[2],
      r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  subwatershed_fits,
  file.path(dir_processed, "09_selected_huc4_subwatershed_fits.csv")
)
```

```{r}
subwatershed_fits %>%
  group_by(terminal_huc4, metabolism_metric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_fits = n(),
    median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2 = median(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_order = min(terminal_order, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_order = max(terminal_order, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

## 7. Order screening audit

```{r}
order_screen_summary <- reach_attributes %>%
  filter(huc4 %in% selected_huc4s) %>%
  count(huc4, order, name = "n_flowlines") %>%
  left_join(
    terminal_candidates %>%
      count(terminal_huc4, terminal_order, name = "n_terminal_candidates"),
    by = c("huc4" = "terminal_huc4", "order" = "terminal_order")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    subwatershed_fits %>%
      count(terminal_huc4, terminal_order, metabolism_metric, name = "n_fits") %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = metabolism_metric,
        values_from = n_fits,
        names_prefix = "n_fits_",
        values_fill = 0
      ),
    by = c("huc4" = "terminal_huc4", "order" = "terminal_order")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_terminal_candidates = replace_na(n_terminal_candidates, 0),
    n_fits_GPP = replace_na(n_fits_GPP, 0),
    n_fits_ER = replace_na(n_fits_ER, 0)
  )

order_screen_summary %>%
  arrange(huc4, order) %>%
  kable()
```

## 8. Scaling changes with terminal stream order {.tabset}

```{r results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
for (selected_huc4 in selected_huc4s) {
  
  cat("\n\n### HUC4 ", selected_huc4, "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  plot_data <- subwatershed_fits %>%
    filter(terminal_huc4 == selected_huc4)
  
  p_slope <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = terminal_order, y = slope)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(color = r2), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = c(0, 1), name = expression(R^2)) +
    facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      x = "Terminal reach order passing fit screens",
      y = "Allometric slope"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(p_slope)
  
  p_r2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = terminal_order, y = r2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(color = slope), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Slope") +
    facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      x = "Terminal reach order passing fit screens",
      y = expression(R^2)
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(p_r2)
}
```
